name: FoxGate AntiVPN (Free)
license: All rights reserved (free edition, not redistributed by this benchmark)

shipped.note: As downloaded: 12 keyless services, IP range lists, maxFlags 5, blocks on detection.

enforce.note: Enforces out of the box; no step needed.

proxycheck_key.note: enforce + the free ProxyCheck key through the product's documented key field (same key for every product).

free_keys.note: Enables the bundled ProxyCheck and VPNAPI service definitions with keys (documented in the service files).

optimal.note: Best documented configuration (METHODOLOGY 4): the 12 shipped services, plus ProxyCheck and VPNAPI with free keys, free keys for ipapi.is and IPLocate (IPLocate's URL gets its {KEY} variable, as its service file allows), and maxFlags 6, the upper end of FoxGate's own recommendation (5 or 6). Simulated on the providers run of 13 Oct with FoxGate's flag fields (hosting counts as a flag): 370 of 378 caught and 5 of 310 refused, against 366 and 7 shipped. A free search found fewer services scoring higher (zowi and ProxyCheck, 2 agree: 377 and 3); that drops ten of FoxGate's shipped services and is fitted to one day's answers, so it is not used. Range lists and modules stay as shipped.

redis_note: No Redis storage option (SQL databases via HikariCP only). Redis test not applicable.
documented_failure_policy: Not documented in the listing; services that fail are skipped (observed).
telemetry: self-updater (configuration.updates.automatic) - blocked so the artifact under test cannot change
list_sources_note: Lists the shipped configuration downloads (from its generated config); used only for the circularity table. central.zowi.gay/tors is FoxGate's Tor list with other providers, also used when the Tor Project is down (author, 7 Oct 2026).
lookup_hosts_note: api.zowi.gay (one GET per player address) was missing until 7 Oct 2026: runs before that sent FoxGate's zowi lookups to the live service in the performance family and left them unfaulted in the failure family.
